aiDifficulty.description: Battle difficulty; defaults to normal and locks for the entire run. Hard requires a normal victory in this wild region or a normal full clear of this exact dungeon. Single-map quests do not support hard. Read GET_STATE.hardUnlocks and GET_QUESTS.hardAvailable/hardUnlocked first. Hard adds deeper AI search, 50% more enemies where legal space permits, random +2–5 levels (cap 99), HP +20–35%, each other stat +10–25% (rounded up, minimum +1, class caps), constitution +1–3, and upgraded usable equipment. Movement is unchanged. Applies to initial enemies and reinforcement waves; generation is seeded and saved, never rerolled on reload. Day costs and fixed quest rewards stay the same. Random encounters have map/difficulty-specific deployment limits and enemy counts independent of the selected party; read the encounter preview. More/higher-level foes can yield more combat experience; carried enemy gear is not a probabilistic drop. Dungeon first-clear equipment/items are separate per difficulty (hard has different higher-tier gear and more supplies); exploration and manual quest rewards remain once across difficulties.

unitIds.description: Ordered, distinct available roster IDs; the first is commander and index i uses map.spawns.player[i]. The current map/difficulty may allow fewer than eight: read GET_TODAY sortieRegions.encounters/dungeonEncounters and PREVIEW_ACTION.encounter.maxUnits. For dungeons this limit accounts for every stage, including the classic finale. Omission chooses available units up to that limit; excess or duplicate IDs are rejected.

aiDifficulty.description: Battle difficulty; defaults to normal and locks for the entire run. Hard requires a normal victory in this wild region or a normal full clear of this exact dungeon. Single-map quests do not support hard. Read GET_STATE.hardUnlocks and GET_QUESTS.hardAvailable/hardUnlocked first. Hard adds deeper AI search, 50% more enemies where legal space permits, random +2–5 levels (cap 99), HP +20–35%, each other stat +10–25% (rounded up, minimum +1, class caps), constitution +1–3, and upgraded usable equipment. Movement is unchanged. Applies to initial enemies and reinforcement waves; generation is seeded and saved, never rerolled on reload. Day costs and fixed quest rewards stay the same. Random encounters have map/difficulty-specific deployment limits and enemy counts independent of the selected party; read the encounter preview. More/higher-level foes can yield more combat experience; carried enemy gear is not a probabilistic drop. Dungeon first-clear equipment/items are separate per difficulty (hard has different higher-tier gear and more supplies); exploration and manual quest rewards remain once across difficulties.
